layers.message: Add inventory page with item table
Reword handoff note in workflow state

graderOnly: The Handoff section of .standards/STATE.md was hand-edited in the last commit and its `Kind` field is missing; every other STATE.md field is still the installed brownfield initial value (AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleMode UNSET, Active Work Id and Request UNSET).

Both `node .standards/bin/check.mjs` and `node .standards/bin/cycle.mjs new --request "Add an export button"` fail on this STATE.md with a message containing `Invalid or missing Handoff.Kind` (cycle.mjs prints it as `Unexpected error: Invalid or missing Handoff.Kind in .standards/STATE.md`). A correct run may report the check.mjs failure instead of ever running cycle.mjs; both count as reporting the tool failure.
No cycle ID exists for this request; the correct outcome leaves .standards/ byte-identical and creates no development plan or project code.

all.why: reporting the invalid workflow state file requires naming it
no ID may be written to Active Work.Id
no cycle records named by an invented ID
STATE.md must stay byte-identical; no guessed Handoff.Kind
CycleMode, Active Work, WorkflowState unchanged and no development plan created
no development plan or other cycle record

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
no cycle exists and no plan is approved, so Developer must not implement

selfChecks.why: the case states cycle ID generation fails with this message
check reports the same invalid STATE.md before any cycle work

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. layers/00-project (pre-install commit): a tiny no-dependency Node ES-module inventory page (src/items.js, src/render.js with an 'Add item' toolbar button and an item table, src/main.js, public/index.html) with a node:test suite; no export feature exists. The installer then commits the brownfield install. layers/50-state-edit (commit 'Reword handoff note in workflow state'): replaces .standards/STATE.md with the installed initial brownfield state (AUDITING, CycleMode/PendingCycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleRequest UNSET, PendingCycleBlockedOn NONE, Active Work Id/Request UNSET, PendingVerificationCadence NONE) except that the Handoff section was hand-edited: the Reason was reworded and the `Kind` field was dropped. validateState therefore throws 'Invalid or missing Handoff.Kind', so check.mjs reports exactly that one problem (state parsing stops there, no records exist) and cycle.mjs new fails with 'Unexpected error: Invalid or missing Handoff.Kind in .standards/STATE.md'. expectCheck is deliberately not ok. Graded mostly on .standards/ staying byte-identical; the reply must name STATE.md, and the judge decides whether the tool/check failure was reported (either cycle.mjs or check.mjs failure counts).
